title: Jumoo Releases package list
description: Packages tracked by scripts/fetch-releases.mjs. See README.md for the full field reference.

nugetId.description: The current NuGet package ID. Used to build package links and as the site's canonical package key.

aliasNugetIds.description: Prior NuGet IDs this package has shipped under (e.g. after a rename). Their version history and download counts are fetched and merged into nugetId's totals. Omit if the package has never changed ID.

title.description: Display name shown on the site. Falls back to nugetId if omitted.

category.description: Groups packages into sections on the homepage (e.g. "uSync", "Integrations"). Leave empty/omit for uncategorized packages, which are listed first with no heading.

githubRepo.description: owner/repo for releases, branches, and commits (the code repo).

issuesRepo.description: owner/repo for issues and PRs, when different from githubRepo - e.g. a package whose code lives in a private repo but whose issues are tracked in a separate public *.Issues repo. Omit if issues/PRs live in githubRepo itself.
